LCOM-CONC.description: Load Combination for Concrete Design (LCOM-CONC). One entry per load combination keyed by combination id; each combination lists its member load cases and factors in vCOMB.

NO.description: Read-only combination number assigned by the program on GET. Ignored on write.

NAME.description: Combination name. Must be unique when adding a new combination.

ACTIVE.description: Active/design type of the combination (e.g. ACTIVE, INACTIVE, STRENGTH, SERVICE); converted to an internal code by the handler.

bES.description: Elastic-stage flag, applied only for the concrete (CONCRETE) load-combination type. true enables the concrete-design elastic-stage option.

bCB.description: Read-only flag set by the program: false = general combination, true = min/max/envelope combination. Ignored on write.

iTYPE.description: Summation method for the combination: 0 = Add, 1 = Envelope, 2 = ABS, 3 = SRSS.

iSERV_TYPE.description: EC service type code (internal, not applied by the current handler).

nLCOMTYPE.description: EC load-combination type code (internal, not applied by the current handler).

nSEISTYPE.description: EC seismic type code (internal, not applied by the current handler).

vCOMB.description: List of member load cases making up this combination.

ANAL.description: Analysis type of the member load case (case-insensitive). ST=Static, RS=Response Spectrum, TH=Time History, MV=Moving, SM=Settlement, ENVL=Envelope, CB=Combination, CS=Construction Stage, etc. Validated at runtime.

LCNAME.description: Load case name; must match an existing load case of the given ANAL type.

FACTOR.description: Load factor applied to this member load case.
